criteria_results.notes: Initial render correct in all sites.

criteria_results.text: When the session's agent/model changes, the pill must update to the new agent's icon/label.
criteria_results.notes: Contract test asserted ONLY the _AgentKindBadge widget in isolation (via AgentKindBadgeTestHarness) with providerId passed in. But the badge renders in FOUR sites and only one call site (_SessionRow, line 777) was actually given providerId. _ResumableSessionRow (846), _TranscriptHeader (1339), and the mini-bubble/expanded-bubble in agent_bubble_overlay.dart were never threaded. Manual smoke: after switching the session model toward a Gemini route (which errored 'Model not found: openrouter/google/gemini-3-flash' and did NOT persist — server session remained anthropic/claude-opus-4-7), the session-list row correctly showed 'Claude Code' while the transcript header and mini-bubble incorrectly showed 'Gemini CLI'. The three sites diverged; the header/bubble reflected a stale/optimistic selection rather than the session's true (server) agent. The contract test gave a false sense of completeness because it tested the widget, not the call sites.

criteria_results.text: After AgentConfigsController.notifyListeners() fires, the badge must rebuild.
criteria_results.notes: context.watch confirmed working for the patched site.

process_issues.description: The #645 contract test verified the _AgentKindBadge widget in isolation but did not assert that every render site (_SessionRow, _ResumableSessionRow, _TranscriptHeader, agent_bubble_overlay) passes the resolved provider. A widget-isolation test cannot catch un-threaded call sites.
process_issues.detected_by: Manual smoke divergence + grep of _AgentKindBadge call sites (4 sites, only 1 patched) and separate badge logic in agent_bubble_overlay.dart.

issues.description: verification-gate emitted PASS for #645 on the strength of green widget tests, but the behavioral-evidence rule was satisfied only at the widget level (AgentKindBadgeTestHarness), not at the user-visible level across all four render sites. The orchestrator caught and fixed an earlier #645 false-green (provider mapping) but did not extend the contract to cover every call site, so a second false-green survived to manual smoke.
issues.detected_by: Manual smoke FAIL after verification-gate PASS; transcript shows the contract test exercised the widget in isolation, not the composing views.

failure_output: Manual smoke: session-list badge='Claude Code' (correct, server=anthropic/claude-opus-4-7); transcript header badge + mini-bubble badge='Gemini CLI' (stale). Panel also showed 'Error: Model not found: openrouter/google/gemini-3-flash ... ProviderModelNotFoundError' — invalid catalog model (separate follow-up).
suggested_follow_up: acceptance-contract for cross-cutting UI fixes must enumerate ALL render sites of the changed widget and assert each composing view, not just the widget in isolation; verification-gate should treat a widget-isolation test as insufficient behavioral evidence when the widget appears in multiple parent views.
